text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 73 vials of mesna 100 mg/mL 10 mL at 3.3 vials per day (22.4 days on hand). Corvale General holds 43 vials at 2.7 vials per day (15.7 days on hand). No active shortage exists at either site.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show mesna is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both campuses. Sagent Pharmaceuticals is the rule-based best option for replenishment; its product is not on FDA's shortage list and its plant is identified as SAGENT PHARMS INC. Alternative manufacturers Bamboo US Bidco LCC, Baxter Healthcare Company, Eugia US LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC are also not on the shortage list, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Place a replenishment order with Sagent Pharmaceuticals — requires buyer approval.
2. Monitor daily usage at both sites and update days-on-hand weekly — requires buyer approval.
3. If Sagent supply becomes constrained, evaluate Bamboo US Bidco LCC, Baxter Healthcare Company, Eugia US LLC, or Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as secondary sources — requires buyer and P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No allocation changes, conservation protocols, or clinical substitutions at this time.
